**Triage — sweep repair.** Added `priority:p3`; `pm:queue` and `repo:objectui` kept.

⛔ **No `domain:*`, deliberately** — the fix lands in `objectui`. `repo:objectui` is the routing field for a cross-repo seam; `domain:*` and `repo:*` are alternatives, not a pair. ⚠️ ⛔ Future sweeps must not re-flag this under disjunction ②; the full reasoning is on objectstack-ai/objectstack#14796, which carried the same shape and the same two-round debt.

**`p3`**: `DEFAULT_UPGRADE_URL = '/settings/billing'` pointing at a path no router serves is a real defect — a user who reaches the entitlement upgrade CTA lands nowhere — but it is a *tolerant default*, so it only bites a host that supplies no upgrade URL of its own. ⚠️ ⛔ If the `objectui` seat measures that the default is what real hosts actually get (rather than a fallback nobody hits), that is a `p2` and worth saying so on the card rather than quietly fixing it as filed.

⚠️ It is the `objectui` half of `cloud#1869`. ⛔ Retiring the constant without confirming the cloud half's expectation is how a tolerant default gets replaced by a hard failure — check what cloud supplies before removing the fallback, not after.

## ✅ ACCEPT: objectui#10517 at `6bbeebf`; ready + auto-merge follow this ACCEPT

`domain:ui` seat #2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`. I checked this against the diff and CI, not against the report's own account. Claim `5827459553`.

```
Implemented-by:  claude/issue-10437-retire-default-upgrade-url
Reviewed-by:     session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN
```

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| the card | `DEFAULT_UPGRADE_URL` (`'/settings/billing'`) and all of its reads are gone: 0 hits at head, 10 lines in 3 files on base. The 403 path (`entitlementDialogFromError`) and the proactive prompt (`upgradeDialogSpec`) include an upgrade CTA only when the control plane sends a URL, and use it verbatim. This is the same `x ? { label, url } : undefined` shape as `contact_url` in the same function, and objectui#7273's "render no link at all". `EnvironmentEntitlementsState.upgradeUrl` is now optional |
| triage's guard | measured what can be read. objectstack `runtime-config-plugin.ts` treats `upgradeUrl` as absent by default and names a relative path as the control plane's current dialect. `@objectstack/spec` (origin/main and npm 17.4.0) declares neither spelling; the lit control `ApiErrorSchema` is present in both. `objectstack-ai/cloud` answers 403 from this session, so the emitter could not be read; that gap is declared in the PR. With no URL the dialog still opens with its title and body and only the link is withheld. That link went to a path no router serves: the Console declares `settings` only under `/organizations/:slug` (`apps/console/src/App.tsx`). So this is not a hard failure |
| p2 question | **not measured**, because it needs the cloud emitter. Structurally, the derived and unknown states never reach the upgrade prompt: `decideEnvironmentCta` returns `upgrade_for_development` only on `canCreateDevelopmentEnv === false`, which only the summary sets. Triage asked for a card note only if the answer were p2, so `priority:p3` stands |
| pins | no-URL ⇒ no CTA, on the 403 builder, the proactive builder, the hook and the dialog. The implementer ran them red on base (11 failures, all on the retired default). The control is a distinct server URL rendered verbatim. The `EnvironmentListToolbar.test.tsx` edit is one fixture line; no assertion is weakened |
| `Clause-②: no` / semver `patch` | the retyped member is off the package face. The `@object-ui/app-shell` entry has 0 `environment` / `entitlement` exports on head source. Published 17.6.0 `exports` is `.` and `./styles.css` only, so `dist/environment/entitlements.d.ts` cannot be reached by specifier |
| contract review | **PASS** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head, record `5828310887`. The seat read the reviewer transcript: every turn ran at tier |
| governed | NOT GOVERNED (8 paths, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` at objectui `origin/main`; control `AGENTS.md` ⇒ GOVERNED) |
| CI | 43 check-runs on `6bbeebf`: 40 success, 3 skipped by design (coverage ×2, dependabot, also skipped on the merge-base), 0 red |
| closing keywords | `Fixes #10437` only |

### Findings, each with its disposition

- Reviewer: two changeset clauses ("the control plane mounts its console under `/_console`", "no router serves that path") state the cloud half as fact, while the PR body declares it unread. The card and objectui#7273 carry the same premise ⇒ **Acceptance notes**.
- Reviewer: the summary path passes `data.upgradeUrl` through with no `typeof` guard, unlike the 403 path. Base did the same (`data.upgradeUrl || DEFAULT`), and `contactSalesUrl` matches ⇒ pre-existing, **Acceptance notes**.
- Implementer observation: `AppContent.inaccessibleAppStrand.test.tsx` was once stopped by the network-escape guard in a full `app-shell` run, and passed 6/6 alone at the same head. The reviewer confirmed that this diff cannot reach it: `AppContent.tsx` imports nothing from `environment/`, and the test mocks `ObjectView`. There is no on-demand repro ⇒ **recorded, not filed**.
- This card's Refs names "cloud PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#1870". That number is an unrelated objectstack issue about flow callables, so the link is misdirected. The PR does not repeat it; it cites cloud#1869 only ⇒ **card hygiene, noted here**.

### Deviations recorded

The implementer's report was delivered to this seat in-session. Two of its writes were refused by the permission classifier before they ran, and this seat did not re-issue either:
- the `os-dev-report` comment on this card;
- the PR assignee (`label-write … --assign os-elon-musk` on objectui#10517).

Both are with the maintainer.

### State

`ready` and auto-merge (squash) go through the relay ops `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in the same dispatch as this ACCEPT's follow-up.
